children.value: > Fact From Story Most of the incoming money, however, went into money market funds, a product with negligible management fees and low profits.
> > Fact From Story Psagot posted a loss of NIS 27 million for the first half of 2023, which is largely attributed to its non-bank credit business, an activity begun before Zim acquired the company.
> > Fact From Story Psagot’s business has been growing, but it is not managing to translate this into profits.
> > > Fact From Story Psagot's incoming money mostly went into money market funds.
> > > Fact From Story Money market funds usually do not generate much profit.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge If the majority of the incoming money went into a low-profit activity, then the overall profit will be low.
> > Commonsense Knowledge If expenses exceed income, then there is a loss.
> Fact From Story Psagot’s mutual funds took in NIS 1.4 billion in October, and NIS 7 billion in the year to the end of October, which means that it has NIS 43 billion under management.
> Commonsense Knowledge High revenue does not guarantee high profit; the costs associated with generating that revenue must also be considered.
